raw.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST Sunday September 13th, 2026

Intro to Position

We are seeking a data-driven and highly creative marketing strategist to grow our audience for NPR’s owned platforms, with a focus on The NPR app. You will act as a guiding force behind NPR’s mobile growth, leveraging data and insights to inform strategies and tactics that migrate audiences to the core digital experience that will define NPR for years to come.

You will manage a dedicated advertising budget, and will also be expected to make the most of NPR’s own channels like our podcasts, broadcast, website, and of course the NPR app’s messaging and UX. You will work closely with the app and web product teams, the audience insights and analytics teams, the content teams and the Network growth teams, and many others while you seek to find loyal users, keep them engaged, and transform this platform into an indispensable daily habit that sustains our journalism and mission.

You will lead test-and-learn campaigns, making data-informed decisions on where we should invest our resources next. Your goal is to understand our audience’s needs, deepen their engagement with our content, and identify exactly where NPR’s app stands out in a crowded landscape, ultimately shaping how public media thrives in a mobile-first world.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

  • Execute Marketing Campaigns: Plan the strategy and messaging for campaigns that give people a clear, compelling reason to download and use the NPR app, translating our trusted journalism into a dynamic, modern mobile experience.
  • Manage Paid and Free/Owned Media: Run ads across social media, search, and video platforms, while also creating promotions for NPR's own radio broadcasts, podcasts, and newsletters to ensure our public service journalism reaches audiences wherever they are.
  • Manage the Budget: Decide how to spend our advertising money effectively to get the best return on investment and the lowest cost per download, helping build a sustainable, digital-first growth engine for the network.
  • Lead Across Teams: Bring together people from the product, analytics, content, and broadcast teams in order to execute campaigns that feel cohesive and true to NPR.
  • Keep Users Coming Back: Build plans (using tools like push notifications, in-app-messages, and emails) to turn first-time downloaders into dedicated returning users, elevating our listeners’ daily routines by making the app an indispensable companion.
  • Understand Our Audience: Research the app landscape to see trends, what others are doing right, figure out where NPR stands out, and make sure our marketing speaks directly to what our audience needs.
  • Test and Improve: Always approach projects with a testing mindset and determine what strategies drive new installs and deeper engagement.
  • Track Success: Track conversions in actionable ways that can help drive near and long-term marketing decisions. You will work closely with our Audience Insights and Product teams to track all your promotional strategies, but especially digital ads and even terrestrial radio promo.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a data-driven marketing role, preferably at a media or tech company

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to thoughtfully establish new cross-team processes, strategies, and tools for collaboration if/when a marketing plan requires something we have never executed before.
  • An execution-focused collaborator who thoughtfully balances team input while maintaining a strong bias for action. You know when to align, but also when to roll up your sleeves and keep things moving.
  • Ability to turn complex numbers into clear, simple stories that inform leadership decisions.
  • A talent for competitive analysis and a deep curiosity about audience behavior.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • A proven track record in both creative marketing campaign management and data-driven performance analysis.
  • Proven ability to manage paid advertising budgets efficiently, especially for mobile app growth.
  • Experience using tracking software, pixels, UTMs, etc. to identify which specific promotions lead to new app users.
  • Substantial experience & comfort building campaigns for a wide variety of marketing messaging channels including but not limited to: email, social media, in-app messaging, display, audio, push notifications, SMS, web notification/pop-ups, in-product UX, etc. (experience with enterprise level cross-channel messaging tools like Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Iterable, or Adobe Campaign/Marketo is a plus)

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $132,508.47-$142,697.13 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Navitus is unable to offer remote work to residents of Alaska, Hawaii, Maine, Mississippi, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Overview

Due to growth, we are adding an Architect, Oracle Functional Solutions to our team!

The Financial ERP Oracle Functional Solutions Architect is the functional architecture authority for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB), with responsibility for solution strategy, functional design, platform governance, release and upgrade planning, integration oversight, and long-term application health. The Architect translates complex finance, billing, revenue management, reporting, control, and operational requirements into scalable and supportable Oracle solutions. This position works directly with Finance, business process owners, product owners, Enterprise Architecture, Data Services, application support teams, internal IT teams, Oracle, and third-party partners to improve business outcomes, maximize delivered Oracle capabilities, and reduce unnecessary customization.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Own and maintain the functional solution architecture and roadmap for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and ORMB.
  • Lead discovery, requirements analysis, fit-gap assessment, future-state process design, solution option evaluation, and functional design decisions.
  • Translate business requirements into process flows, solution blueprints, functional specifications, configuration decisions, integration requirements, reporting requirements, controls, and test scenarios.
  • Prioritize delivered Oracle capabilities and recommend extensions or customization only when justified by business value, risk, and supportability.
  • Assess cross-platform impacts and maintain alignment across billing, receivables, payables, cash management, general ledger, financial reporting, master data, security, and related processes.
  • Develop and maintain architecture standards, decision records, design documentation, configuration rationale, and reusable solution patterns.
  • Provide functional architecture leadership for implemented Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP capabilities, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, and other approved financial modules.
  • Partner with Finance to align configuration and process design with accounting, reconciliation, close, reporting, audit, and internal-control requirements.
  • Evaluate enhancement requests and recommend solutions that improve financial process effectiveness, data quality, controls, usability, and platform sustainability.
  • Assess Oracle update and release impacts and provide direction for configuration review, business readiness, regression testing, and adoption of applicable capabilities.
  • Provide functional architecture leadership across ORMB customer and account structures, pricing, billing, receivables, payments, adjustments, collections, delinquency, financial interfaces, and related revenue-management functions.
  • Lead ORMB fit-gap analysis and recommend product-based, configurable, and supportable approaches.
  • Apply working knowledge of ORMB architecture and the Oracle Utilities Application Framework to evaluate functional options, dependencies, upgrade impacts, and approved extensions.
  • Partner with business owners and technical teams on the functional behavior of ORMB integrations, conversions, reports, invoice outputs, batch processing, and exception handling.
  • Provide functional oversight for integrations connecting Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and ORMB with Oracle Integration Cloud, enterprise data platforms, financial institutions, reporting solutions, and approved upstream and downstream systems.
  • Define and validate functional requirements for inbound and outbound interfaces, APIs, files, batch processes, sequencing, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and recovery.
  • Ensure financial, billing, operational, and reconciliation reporting requirements are included in end-to-end solution designs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
  • Oracle certification in Fusion Cloud ERP, ORMB, or related Oracle capability preferred.
  • 10+ years of relevant enterprise application experience, including progressively responsible functional design, implementation, or solution architecture responsibilities required.
  • 10+ years of Oracle Financials, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, ORMB, or related enterprise financial application experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Revenue Management and Billing required.
  • Experience leading a full implementation, major transformation, or comparable lifecycle across discovery, fit-gap, design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization required.
  • Strong knowledge of finance, accounting, billing, receivables, revenue-management, reconciliation, financial-control, and enterprise-reporting processes required.
  • Experience setting application strategy and providing architecture recommendations for scaling, enhancing, and sustaining enterprise systems required.
  • Experience designing solutions that span multiple applications, integrations, data flows, scheduled processes, reports, and business functions required.
  • Knowledge of ITIL service-management concepts and application lifecycle governance required.
  • Strong knowledge of ORMB billing and receivables and working knowledge of the Oracle Utilities Application Framework preferred.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud and functional design of APIs, services, file-based integrations, and scheduled processes preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, insurance, financial services, utilities, or another complex billing environment preferred.
  • Experience with Oracle update and upgrade management, regression-test strategy, test automation, and managed-service support models preferred.
  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy, security, audit, and regulatory requirements preferred.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

raw.excerpt: Your missionPierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products.
raw.description:
Your mission

Pierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products. We are looking for creative, highly motivated individuals to help to drive the successful launch of tabelecleucel (Tab-cel), as part of the initial Cellular Therapy Director (CTAD) team, you will be focused on delivering results with innovative solutions for complex patients suffering from a devastating rare disease, Epstein-Barr Virus Positive Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (EBV+ PTLD). Patients with a history of bone marrow or solid organ transplant can suffer from this rare, often deadly lymphoma. This is an opportunity for “builders” those who are looking to contribute to the creation of a new US organization, with a potentially transformative therapy, and we are looking for candidates that have a growth mindset and thrive in a start-up environment that will be scaling up the Pierre Fabre presence in the US pharmaceuticals market. We value individuals who exhibit behaviors such as team collaboration, humility, innovative thinking, and a patient-centric approach to the business.

In the preapproval phase, the CTAD will be responsible for leading disease awareness efforts, developing relationships with both the clinical and non-clinical experts to understand unmet need and patient journey, as well as leading the onboarding process for launching an allogeneic cell therapy. Post-approval, the CTADs will be responsible for appropriately driving demand and working cross functionally to support utilization and treatment experience of Tab-cel within institutions in their assigned territory.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities

  • Effectively navigate complex account environments by identifying and understanding the needs and challenges of diverse stakeholders and proactively collaborating with other internal functions: medical, value and access, and cell therapy operations to provide targeted support.

  • Integrate customer insights and analytical data to design and execute strategic account plans. Develop a deep understanding of customer dynamics and market trends to identify opportunities, uncover barriers to treatment, and drive actionable insights.

  • Equip treatment center staff with process training that will eliminate barriers to use and optimize operational workflows so that appropriate patients have access to products.

Pre-approval: Disease state education, Site of Care onboarding, Market mapping and research

  • Identify and engage with medical experts in the fields of Cell Therapy, bone marrow transplant (BMT), lymphoma, and solid organ transplantation (SOT) who manage Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (PTLD) to understand proliferation of disease and referral patterns

  • Understand process at cell therapy and transplant centers and engage on process mapping and potential onboarding requirements for allogeneic cell therapies

  • Educate physicians on severity of disease, unmet medical need, and current standard of care and patient journey

  • Create and maintain detailed site account plans

  • Work closely, coordinating with other PFP functions to ensure an efficient, professional customer experience that support expedited access to Tab-celEbvallo for appropriate patients

  • Institutional mapping which includes understanding of operational process, patient flow within institutions, and patient referral networks

  • Successfully execute territory business plans which include account specific KPIs and tactics

  • Partner with external stakeholders at sites; service line directors, administrators, coordinators, and pharmacy committees, transplant administrators, and medical societies and map relevant processes

  • Collaborate with marketing in the development of US promotional materials to prepare for launch

  • Facilitating cross-functional relationships and ownership of relationship with key commercial stakeholders within target institutions

  • Provide support at professional meetings, including staffing exhibits, reporting on scientific sessions and facilitating meetings with medical experts

  • Account leadership: drive collaboration and communication with internal field-facing cross functional teams, market access, medical affairs, and cell therapy technical operations team

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities and adhere to all US State and Federal Regulations

Post Approval: (Includes all Pre-Approval Activities

  • Competitively promote Tab-celEbvallo through a deep knowledge of the EBV + PTLD landscape, product knowledge and best-in-class clinical expertise.

  • Share relevant account and HCP insights with cross-functional partners, highlighting business trends, competitive shifts, and changes in the therapeutic landscape. Support stakeholders to ensure both their and the patient experience is positive and seamless.

  • Drive appropriate utilization of Pierre Fabre products through exchange on product attributes and providing a seamless customer experience

  • Educate on efficacy and safety of Tab-cel for adoption in appropriate patients

  • Create a sense of urgency to treat patients with Tab-cel by utilizing approved promotional materials

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as required based on evolving business needs.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • At least 10 years of experience within the biopharma industry

  • Deep expertise in of the following areas is required: cell or gene therapy service lines

  • Demonstrated experience in participating in a collaborative and complex matrix environment

  • Ability to understand and covey complex treatment modalities and demonstrated high scientific aptitude

  • Sales experience in ultra rare disease, ideally CGT

  • Ability to appropriately access and handle business information in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and / or Pierre Fabre policies

  • A passion for making a difference in the lives of patients

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Launch experience in a high acuity therapeutic area such as ultra rare disease

  • Existing relationships in cell therapy, bone marrow transplantation, solid organ transplantation service lines

  • Experience managing large geographies

  • Experience in rare oncology and/ or transplant setting

  • Demonstrated record of successful account management in large academic institution

LOCATION: US, Remote with regular daily and overnight travel expected within given business territory up to 70%

Compensation and Benefits:

Anticipated Salary Range: $170,000 - $250,000

This range represents the base annual full-time salary for all positions within the applicable job grade. The actual salary offer will depend on a range of factors including experience, education, location, and other relevant qualifications. This position is also eligible for a Pierre Fabre bonus, commission, or incentive program in addition to the base pay.

Employees will be eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan, a generous PTO policy, paid company holidays, and paid parental leave. Additional offerings include employee discounts on our products, professional development opportunities, and access to mental health and wellness programs

Pierre Fabre

Pierre Fabre has been recognized by Forbes as one of the "World's Best Employers" for the 3rd year running.

True to My Nature

Who you are ?

Pierre Fabre is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant because of race, creed, color, age, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender expression and identity, disability, genetic information, veteran status, military status, application for military service or any other class protected by state or federal law.

Pediatrics Admin & Front Office Support

Remote | Pediatrics | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $5-$6/hour
Target Start Date: September 14, 2026
Future Schedule: Expected to increase to approximately 40 hours/week as the practice opens and patient volume grows

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and adaptable Virtual Medical Assistant to support a growing pediatric practice during its pre-opening and early growth stages.

This is not a traditional, narrowly defined Medical VA position. During the startup phase, you will work closely with the physician as an administrative and personal assistant, helping coordinate meetings, calendars, vendors, projects, communications, and clinic setup activities.

As the practice begins seeing patients, your responsibilities will gradually transition toward front-office and medical administrative support, including scheduling, patient intake, insurance verification, and patient communication.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a growing environment where priorities can change, takes ownership without needing constant reminders, and can independently identify what needs to be done next.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive, Administrative & Calendar Support

  • Manage and organize the physician's calendars, ensuring meetings, deadlines, agendas, links, documents, and preparation materials are consolidated in one place.

  • Attend administrative and vendor meetings as needed, take clear notes, document action items, and help ensure important follow-ups are completed.

  • Serve as a proactive accountability partner by tracking deadlines, projects, tasks, and outstanding items without requiring constant reminders.

2. Front Office & Patient Communication

  • Manage incoming patient calls, emails, texts, voicemails, and initial inquiries professionally once the clinic begins accepting patients.

  • Assist prospective and existing families with scheduling, follow-ups, basic questions, and other front-office communication needs.

  • Provide a warm, professional first point of contact that reflects the patient-centered experience expected from a pediatric practice.

3. Patient Scheduling, Intake & Registration

  • Coordinate end-to-end patient scheduling, including new patient appointments, follow-ups, rescheduling, and appointment-related communication.

  • Support patient intake and check-in by ensuring required demographic, administrative, and insurance information is collected accurately.

  • Maintain organized patient information and appointment records within eClinicalWorks (eCW) while following established clinic workflows.

4. Insurance Verification & Administrative Support

  • Verify commercial insurance coverage and determine whether patient insurance plans are active, pending, or require additional follow-up.

  • Complete insurance eligibility and benefit verification before appointments and document findings accurately for the practice.

  • Assist with insurance-related administrative tasks and potentially prior authorizations as clinic processes expand.

5. Vendor, Research & Project Coordination

  • Research vendors, clinic equipment, software, and other operational needs and compare available options based on cost, features, and suitability.

  • Organize research findings, pricing comparisons, project updates, and recommendations using spreadsheets and other tracking tools.

  • Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders to keep clinic setup projects progressing according to established timelines.

6. Process Documentation & SOP Development

  • Document recurring workflows and administrative processes as the clinic develops its operating procedures.

  • Create clear step-by-step SOPs for tasks such as scheduling, patient communication, insurance verification, and other recurring activities.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to organize, standardize, and improve workflows as the practice grows.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is REQUIRED. Candidates without prior eCW experience should not be considered.

  • 1+ years previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Assistant, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong administrative, organizational, calendar-management, and task-management skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English with the confidence to communicate professionally with patients, families, vendors, and healthcare professionals.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to organize information, research, projects, and workflows independently.

  • Highly proactive and able to recognize what needs attention without waiting to be reminded.

  • Comfortable working in a startup-style environment where responsibilities and priorities may evolve.

  • Able to multitask effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable using required secure networks, clinic systems, and productivity tracking software.

Strongly Preferred

  • Previous experience working in pediatrics.

  • Experience performing commercial insurance verification.

  • Experience handling prior authorizations for commercial insurance or HMO plans.

  • Experience supporting a physician, clinic owner, executive, or small medical practice.

  • Basic Canva or graphic-editing skills for simple social media or clinic content.

Tools & Systems

Candidates may work with:

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW) EMR, REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • RingRX or similar HIPAA-compliant phone systems

  • Google Calendar or other multi-calendar systems

  • Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet tools

  • Canva

  • Secure private networks/VPNs

  • Productivity tracking software

What Success Looks Like

You will succeed in this role if you become someone the physician can trust to take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate what needs to happen next, and keep important tasks from falling through the cracks.

You should be able to work independently, organize competing priorities, communicate professionally with families, and help create systems that allow the physician to focus more heavily on patient care.

As the practice grows, success will also mean helping create a smooth patient experience from the first phone call through scheduling, intake, insurance verification, and ongoing follow-up.

Job Description

The Opportunity

Embry-Riddle Student Recruitment is seeking a dynamic individual to join their team as the Assistant Director of Student Recruitment (ADR). The ADR is responsible for regional recruitment, outreach, public relations and marketing to meet enrollment goals for their designated region/market. This person provides civilian and military prospective students and leads with relevant information regarding University programs and services and next steps towards enrollment through virtual, phone, email communication. The role oversees and supervises assigned Regional Recruitment Counselor(s) (RCs) to ensure territory performance and goals are met and evaluates the effectiveness of all recruitment and engagement activities and events.

The ADR will be responsible for developing a regional strategy to represent the University in a variety of forums to meet and recruit prospective students, promote programs, establish contacts at local, regional and national industry, college, transfer and military fairs. This person will select, plan and execute event attendance, and conduct University presentations regionally to individuals and groups of prospective students and businesses, both in-person and virtually.

The ADR fosters relationships with appropriate contacts to include, Education Service Officers (ESO) (where applicable), Human Resource Managers, Training Managers, and Enrollment/Marketing liaisons, as applicable. This role also works closely with other departments to ensure coordination of all recruitment and admissions activities and ensures that all University policies and procedures are enforced.

This is a remote role and moderate travel is required. Please note that due to staffing needs, this position is open to all candidates currently residing in or planning to relocate to any of the following states: CT, DE, DC, IN, MD, MA, MI, NH, NJ, OH, PA, RI, VI, VT, WV.

​This position will require travel time away from the office. May work evenings, weekends and/or holidays as required.

About us

For over 100 years, Embry-Riddle has been the world's leading aviation and aerospace university, educating more than 30,000 students across residential campuses in Daytona Beach, Florida, and Prescott, Arizona, as well as through a global network of Worldwide locations and online programs. With more than 165,000 alumni around the world, our impact reaches every corner of the aerospace, aviation, defense and technology industries.

Today, our faculty, researchers and professional staff are advancing innovation across aviation, space, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, autonomous systems and next-generation engineering. Working alongside industry leaders, government agencies and innovators, they are solving real-world challenges and shaping the technologies that will define tomorrow.

Whether you are an educator, researcher, administrator, technologist or industry professional, your work at Embry-Riddle will contribute to something bigger than a job. Join a community driven by discovery, purpose and excellence—and help shape the future of aerospace.

  • Generous Time Off:Enjoy up to 18 days of paid leave in your first year, including 3 days granted upon hire and 15 days accrued throughout the year. You'll also receive 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day.

  • Tuition Coverage:Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.

  • Retirement Contributions:ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.

  • Personal Leave:Relax with 15 days of personal leave for non-exempt employees or 18 days for exempt full-time employees in your first year.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Analytical skills with an in-depth knowledge of information systems and technical expertise with Microsoft operating systems, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook/email, and Internet end-user applications

  • Proven track record for consistently meeting deadlines with the ability to tactfully handle difficult situations and maintain composure under pressure, often under tight deadlines.

  • Must be a dynamic, motivated, and enthusiastic individual with professional recruitment experience in higher education.

  • Must be able to provide excellent customer service to coworkers, staff, students, faculty, and customers.

  • Must demonstrate exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Must demonstrate a high standard of personal conduct, professionalism, and integrity and the ability to maintain confidentiality is vital.

  • Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision and demonstrate a willingness to seek guidance and direction as necessary for the performance of duties.

  • Must be able to recognize and deal with priorities, recognize, and perform duties not directly assigned.

  • Must be able to investigate, problem-solve and take corrective action.

  • Moderate travel required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree

  • Marketing/advertising experience

  • Prior experience in higher education administration, marketing, and/or counseling

  • Aviation experience

Requirements to be able to drive a university vehicle:

  • Must possess and maintain a valid US driver’s license.

  • Must meet the University’s standards for approved drivers. Unacceptable driving records (as stated in the Use of Equipment and Vehicles Procedure 1.17) include the following (for three years from the date of each occurrence):

    • Three (3) or more at-fault accidents and/or moving violations in the previous 36 months.

    • Two (2) or more at-fault accidents or two (2) or more moving violations in the past year.

    • Conviction for driving while impaired (DWI, DUI within the last five (5) years).

    • Conviction for death by vehicle, hit and run, racing, careless and reckless driving, implied consent in the previous five (5) years.

    • Serious violations result in immediate disqualification and revocation of driver privileges. The following are examples of serious violations​:

    • Speeding over 15 mph of the posted limit, driving under the Influence of alcohol or drugs, leaving the scene of an accident, reckless or careless.

To submit your application for this opportunity, please visit theEmbry-Riddle Career Siteand search for requisition number R312044. Please attach all relevant materials to your application when you apply online. Complete submissions include:

  • Cover letter

  • Resume

  • Contact information for at least three professional references (please note that references may be contacted as part of the interview/screening process)

Current Embry-Riddle employees:Please apply directly through the ERAU Employee Hub Central application within Workday.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions' innovations, products, and services play essential roles in people's lives. Our end-to-end suite of software solutions helps customers manage emergency communications, process video and evidence, and leverage cutting-edge AI-driven analytics for security and operational insights. We are industry leaders in video security and analytics, with solutions deployed in more than 120 countries across diverse environments such as school campuses, transportation systems, healthcare centers, public venues, critical infrastructure, prisons, factories, casinos, airports, financial institutions, government facilities, and retailers. Our AI-powered security solutions integrate advanced video analytics, machine learning, and embedded intelligence to enable proactive threat detection, enhanced situational awareness, and automated decision-making.


Job Description

The Director of Computer Vision will drive the technical vision, research and engineering execution for the platform, with focus on the following core areas:

  • Foundational Research Strategy:Define the long-term research agenda for fundamental computer vision capabilities and drive the culture of scientific excellence.

  • Technical Vision, Engineering Leadership, and Execution:Provide executive technical leadership to a unified research and engineering organization, defining the technical architecture, strategy, and engineering roadmap for the Computer Vision Platform. Drive execution, ensuring the seamless translation of product requirements into robust technical specifications and successful delivery of next-generation visual intelligence solutions that are highly scalable and align with overall product and business strategy.

  • Organizational Leadership and Talent Strategy:Manage and scale a unified computer vision research and engineering organization distributed across multiple geographies, overseeing multiple teams, and defining the strategy for recruiting, mentoring, and attracting world-class talent.

  • End-to-End MLOps and Deployment:Own the entire engineering lifecycle for central, reusable computer vision models and foundational AI infrastructure. This includes establishing best-in-class MLOps practices for scalable training, efficient deployment, continuous monitoring, and performance optimization across edge and cloud environments.

  • Performance Measurement and Continuous Improvement:Define, implement, and track key technical performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, model efficiency, system reliability) to measure engineering success, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement in execution and delivery.

Completion of a Master’s Degree level Family Nurse Practitioner program with current National Board Certification and State of Employment license to practice in the Advanced Practice Nurse role required

Position Overview

The Industry Strategy Manager of Digital Project Delivery will play a critical role in supporting a team that defines the strategy and go-to-market growth strategies for Autodesk’s project data management, collaboration, and design management solutions.

You will contribute to a team that defines and executes on the industry strategy, including market opportunity analysis, customer value propositions, competitive analysis, partnerships, target audiences, and business models. You will work with cross-functional teams across Product, Platform, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

You must possess deep knowledge in BIM, have delivered digital projects across multiple disciplines, and have experience in implementing an ISO 19650 process. This includes managing Common Data Environments (CDE), project information, industry data standards, and data governance and quality. You will need to be an effective communicator who thinks strategically, writes concisely, speaks easily to small and large audiences and is a coalition builder. You must have the appropriate skills to work across a matrixed organization, use data to drive effective business decisions, and bring recommendations forward rather than wait for direction.

Autodesk is in a period of exciting and dynamic change as we continue to expand market share through various business growth initiatives and our transition to cloud. The successful candidate will have input into the shape, direction, and growth of the organisation as we transition through this change and plan for the future.

  • Lead cross-functional programs that take a data management initiative from strategy through launch, coordinating across teams to a shared plan and timeline

  • Translate ISO 19650 information management practice into product requirements and market-facing positioning

  • Work with the strategy team to create business cases to drive sales channels, partnerships, and mergers & acquisitions, and the executive briefings that carry them

  • Work with product teams to clearly communicate key customer value propositions and workflow requirements, representing the voice of the customer on price, package, position, and business models

  • Monitor business performance; document and report on usage, adoption, customer acquisition and retention, and adjust go-to-market plans

  • Build and maintain the business plan for data management growth, including adoption, expansion, and customer migration paths

  • Work with sales to develop and achieve success, define and develop appropriate sales plays and tools, and support marketing execution to create the content behind them

  • Represent Autodesk within industry organisations and at industry events, including data standards and information management bodies, and as a point of contact for industry specialists, research analysts, key press, and other third parties

Founded in 1988, Hellenic Systems Ltd builds the systems that run the factory floor. Our software tells operators what to make and in what order, records what actually happened, and proves it to an auditor afterwards. The industry name for this is Manufacturing Execution Systems, or MES: the layer that sits between a company’s business systems and the machinery and people producing the goods. We design and manufacture the hardware that goes with it as well.

We are UK-based and serve over 130 sites across the UK and Europe. Our roots are in food manufacturing, particularly meat and poultry, and we are now extending into any manufacturer with the same problem to solve. A large share of what we ship is built specifically for one customer, which is why our tagline, Built Around You, is meant literally.

Our three software products are CARCASE, our kill line and livestock system, FOPS, our Factory Order Processing System, and FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system. Our hardware includes weigh scales, touch screen terminals, outer case marking systems, carcass data capture units and label printers.

Since 2023 we have been part of Vesta Software Group, which sits within Jonas Software, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. Constellation is one of the largest acquirers of vertical market software businesses in the world.

We are also unusually far along with AI for a business our size. It is embedded in how we build software and how we work day to day, not run as a side project, and we expect everyone here to use it.

The Opportunity

FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system, has been rebuilt as a new product and is our main new business push. It guides operators through ingredient weigh-up, enforces tolerances, captures batch and operator evidence, and connects to shop floor weighing and labelling hardware. The buyers are food and drink manufacturers who still run weigh-up on paper, spreadsheets or an awkward ERP screen, and who are under real pressure on allergen control, traceability and waste.

This is a new role. It exists to build and convert a new business pipeline that does not depend on our existing account base.

Job Summary

The Business Development Manager owns new business at Hellenic. The role is targeted on winning new named clients and new sites, starting with FORMIX and broadening into our wider software and hardware portfolio as the pipeline develops. It is a hunting role: self-generated prospecting, campaigns and networking, then running the opportunity through demonstration, proposal, negotiation and close, with support from our technical and commercial teams.

The BDM reports to the Head of Commercial and works alongside our Account Managers, who own existing customer relationships. Growth inside existing accounts stays with them. Anything genuinely new belongs to the BDM.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Business Generation

  • Win new named clients and new sites, principally for FORMIX in year one, broadening into CARCASE, FOPS, hardware and bespoke development as the pipeline matures.

  • Generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns, trade events and industry networking. Marketing and referral leads will supplement this, not replace it.

  • Work the named FORMIX prospect list and the wider addressable market, including manufacturers outside our traditional meat and poultry base, such as bakery, dairy, ready meals, sauces, seasonings, flavourings and beverages.

  • Open the first opportunities in adjacent sectors as we extend the product into adjacent sectors, and feed what you learn back into product and pricing.

  • Qualify hard and early. We would rather have a smaller pipeline we believe in than a large one we do not.

2. Selling and Closing

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, on-site assessment, demonstration (in person and remote), proposal, commercial negotiation and close.

  • Build the business case in the customer’s language: reduced giveaway and waste, right first time batches, allergen control, audit-ready evidence and labour saved on the weigh-up line.

  • Prepare and present quotations and proposals that reflect our pricing model, including site-level and tiered packaging.

  • Present our solution accurately and never oversell what the product does. Where a requirement needs bespoke development, involve the technical team for scope.

  • Hand over cleanly to Projects and Support at the point of sale, including a written summary of what has been sold and what the customer expects.

3. Market, Product and Competitor Knowledge

  • Build and hold working knowledge of the FORMIX proposition and enough of the wider portfolio to spot an opportunity when a customer describes a problem.

  • Know the competition. Be able to explain where we win and where we do not.

  • Gather field intelligence on competitor pricing, bundling and contract terms.

  • Track sector trends, regulation and retailer or certification pressures (for example BRCGS) that create a reason for customers to act.

4. Pipeline, CRM and Reporting

  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of sufficient size and quality to deliver the agreed targets, with realistic close dates and values.

  • Keep CRM current and accurate. Every opportunity, activity, contact and next step is logged.

  • Report weekly on activity, pipeline movement and forecast, and present your numbers at commercial reviews.

  • Learn and follow the company sales guidelines and standard operating procedures, and help improve our proposal and correspondence templates as you go.

  • Use AI tools in your daily workflow: prospect and account research, first-draft proposals and follow-ups, call preparation and pipeline analysis. We will give you the tools and the training.

5. Working With the Team

  • Work with the Account Managers so that new business and account growth do not collide, and pass leads to them where an opportunity sits inside an existing relationship.

  • Work with Development, Projects and Support on solution scoping, demonstrations and delivery expectations.

  • Contribute to campaigns, marketing content, case studies and event planning.

  • Attend training to keep product, sector and sales skills current, and take part in team meetings and reviews.

  • Carry out other reasonable duties related to the promotion, sale and delivery of our products as directed by the management team.

Targets and Measures of Success

You will carry a personal new business target, set annually with the Head of Commercial and reviewed each quarter. It covers new order value, new recurring revenue and a minimum number of genuinely new clients, and it is supported by activity and pipeline coverage measures and by the quality of what you put into the CRM.

The targets are built from our FORMIX commercial plan and are deliberately achievable for someone who prospects properly. We will share the detail, including the numbers and how the commission scheme works against them, at the interview stage.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential

  • Proven track record of winning new business in a B2B environment, carrying and hitting a personal new business target.

  • Experience selling a considered purchase with a multi-month sales cycle and more than one decision maker, typically operations, quality, engineering, IT and finance.

  • Comfortable self-generating pipeline.

  • Able to hold a credible conversation on a factory floor and translate an operational problem into a commercial proposal.

  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including the ability to write a proposal that stands on its own.

  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with the discipline to protect margin.

  • Confident with CRM discipline and accurate forecasting.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your working day. You do not need to be technical, but you do need to be someone who reaches for them rather than avoids them.

  • Full UK driving licence, and willing to travel across the UK, including overnight stays. Most of our target market sits in a band from the Midlands up through Yorkshire and the Humber into the North West, so a home base within reach of that corridor is an advantage, though we will consider strong candidates anywhere in the UK.

Desirable

  • Experience selling into food and drink manufacturing, or into another regulated manufacturing sector.

  • Familiarity with MES, ERP, traceability, weighing or labelling systems, or with production and quality processes in a manufacturing plant.

  • Experience selling a combined hardware, software and services solution rather than software alone.

  • Experience opening a new market or launching a new product into an existing customer base.

  • A strong existing network of contacts in food and drink manufacturing, at operations, quality, engineering or director level. If you can open doors on day one, tell us.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in a sales role, for research, drafting, call preparation or pipeline analysis.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!
We are looking for an experienced Strategic Enterprise Account Executive to join our Sales team to manage the most critical prospect and customer accounts. In this hunter role, you will be responsible for building and executing the strategy to develop cold accounts into customers, while also working closely with Customer Success to grow current customer accounts. Enjoys being part of a small fast paced start up environment and is a self starter. Experience in selling digital transformational SaaS solutions to verticals in FinTech, Banking, Insurance, Mortgage/Title. Prior knowledge of product solutions selling security, identity verification or eSign is a plus. Thrives in creative problem solving with a challenger sales mentality. This position requires regular travel to attend trade shows, meet customers, and build relationships. This is a high-profile individual contributor role with commensurate compensation. Remote working environment.

As our Strategic Account Executive, you will:

  • Orchestrate and close profitable growth contracts that exceed $1M in committed annual revenue selling as a team.
  • Establish executive relationships within prospect, customer, and partner accounts.
  • Become a subject matter expert in digital identity, fraud prevention, and trusted online transactions.
  • Develop and execute custom account plans for each assigned account.
  • Independently own a successful outbound pipeline generation strategy.
  • Professionally manage daily deal progression activities with a sense of urgency.
  • Lead the review and negotiation of contractual agreements in partnership with Legal.
  • Perform business reporting and forecasting duties within Salesforce and company systems
  • Communicate effectively in writing leveraging Slack, Google Suite, and email.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams outside of GTM to improve our company and take advantage of market opportunities.

As our Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you should have:

  • Demonstrable track record closing $1M/year new logo SaaS contracts with Fortune 1000 accounts.
  • Experience in identity verification, digital identity, or identity infrastructure, with exposure to areas such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), fraud and risk, AML/KYC, or trust and safety solutions highly preferred.
  • The desire for feedback and coaching.
  • Existing relationships within key accounts.
  • Tremendous business acumen and judgment.
  • Strong analytical skills with an attention to detail.
  • Executive presence.
  • Technical proficiency with modern enterprise software productivity tools.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a problem-solving orientation.

Position logistics:

    Travel: This role requires approximately 50% travel, including regular customer visits, team meetings, and industry events.

Our Proof Pillars:

  • Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
  • 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
  • Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
  • Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
  • Monthly work from home stipend
  • Professional development credit
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
  • And more!
This position will be posted and accepting applications through September 11, 2026.

It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

This role will be covering the Central US region that will generally cover everything west of the Mississippi to Colorado.

  • Work with project supervision and management to create safety solutions to safety concerns.

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of progressively responsible EHS experience supporting construction, renewable energy, industrial, manufacturing, utility, or energy related operations.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting utility-scale or commercial solar PV construction projects, BESS, and/or solar O&M activities.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong working knowledge of electrical safety, NFPA 70e, lockout/tagout, arc flash hazard mitigation, and energized work practices.

  • Demonstrated experience applying both OSHA Construction (29 CFR 1926) and General Industry (29 CFR 1910) standards is preferred.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Procore, and other basic computer skills.

  • Must be organized, proactive and have proven experience in OSHA Compliance.

  • Skillful communicator in both verbal and written communication to influence leaders, project teams, and subcontractors to achieve safety excellence.

  • Excellent writing skills with proper grammar.

  • A great listener who can communicate professionally and in an open and positive approach.

  • CSP, ASP, SMS, or other recognized professional safety certifications are preferred.

  • Board Certified Safety Professional certifications are preferred (e.ge. CHST, OHST, etc.)

  • Current First Aid & CPR certification is required.

  • Valid driver’s license in good standing issued by state of residence.

Actual pay will depend on factors such as internal equity, skills, experience, education, certifications, and location. This range supports our commitment to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. Compensation may vary by work location, including remote arrangements.

The role of a Entry-level communications specialist at Canonical

We’re on the look out for a brilliant B2B Social Media Marketing Manager to join our team and take our communications to the next level. Our social media provides a window between the people who make our products and those who use them. With audiences in the millions, our online communities have the opportunity to talk to us, engage with us, provide feedback and be involved in the world of Ubuntu. From #opensource to coffee on K8s, launch previews to twitter storms over some cool release swag, our marketing team is committed to creating conversations with audiences all over planet earth: developers, tech enthusiasts, security engineers...

The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They prefer to work in an environment that emphasises ownership of campaigns, collaboration, learning, curiosity and a drive to continually improve oneself / the team / the organisation. They love to problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation to make daily life easier.

This role sits in the communications team reporting to the director of communications.

Location:This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

What your day will look like

  • Create, schedule and publish content and campaigns across multiple social media channels
  • Deliver regular analysis and reporting on social media metrics, content performance and campaigns results
  • Support the growth and nurturing of Canonical’s social media audiences, while increasing engagement rates and valuable actions
  • Develop flair with copywriting and asset creation to create messaging that aligns with the brand and its personality, and drives audiences towards action
  • Be responsible for executing A/B and multivariate growth tests
  • Be audience centric, focusing on platform and community moderation, as well as direct audience engagement
  • Create awareness on integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content
  • Package all of Canonical’s product offerings and educational material creatively, from bare metal, AI, Kubernetes to chats on diversity and CSR.

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience managing social media platforms for tech brands, part of a content team or marketing agency
  • Hands-on knowledge of social media management tools, an understanding of web analytics tools (social and web)
  • Proficiency with at least four social media platforms including LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and Reddit
  • An analytical eye and a good sense for the type of content that performs best depending on platform and objective
  • Experience with educational content funnels, and using video as a core social media marketing asset
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and aptitude for forging trusting relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong content marketer
  • Proven ability to prioritise and differentiate what matters from the noise, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.title: Clinical Regulatory Affairs Specialist II - Remote US
raw.excerpt: It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission. Our people are the foundation of our success.
raw.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Description

Our Regulatory Affairs Specialist II primary responsibilities include managing and planning regulatory affairs compliance for industry sponsors and/or sites in networks. This position will work closely with the regulatory affairs management, department director and/or primary investigators to ensure compliance, preparing for auditing activities while meeting strict deadlines. The Regulatory Affairs Specialist I will maintain a full study workload with minimal supervision.

This position is a US-based remote position; relocation assistance and work sponsorship are not available.

Duties include and are not limited to:

  • Establishes and maintains a document management system for regulatory electronic files

  • Maintains FDA and GCP required regulatory documentation for individual sites, studies, sponsors and/or other networks. Ensures all regulatory documentation is compliant with local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for format and content

  • Maintains critical documentation ensuring compliance

  • Modifies and/or develops informed consent forms and updates and manages protocol, investigator drug brochure and consent form modifications or amendments in compliance with IRB policy and HIPAA. This includes time sensitive correspondence with sponsors and other stakeholders.

  • Organizes and processes documentation for IRB submission for multiple trials

  • Processing of Protocol Deviations that meet the IRB reportable criteria

  • Submits urgent safety notifications to the IRB

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications for success include:

  • Associate's Degree or higher is preferred, high school graduation diploma required - qualified experience may be substituted for education

  • 3+ years' regulatory affairs work experience in a clinical research, pharmaceutical, site management organization highly desired

  • Knowledge of medical terminology, FDA, other regulatory processes highly preferred

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. Ton rôle, en bref :

En tant qu’Analyste intermédiaire, tu auras pour principal focus les travaux entourant la modernisation de notre logiciel de gestion Hopem Immobilier vers une nouvelle plateforme technologique.

Le candidat recherché doit démontrer des compétences supérieures à la moyenne en analyse et documentation par sa capacité à constamment améliorer l’ensemble des processus de développement dans un environnement agile. Possédant un niveau d’engagement supérieur démontré par l’action, le candidat doit également avoir un niveau d’autonomie très développé.

Tu feras partie d’une équipe de développement solide et en pleine évolution technologique et tu seras accompagné d’autres analystes expérimentés.

Le travail se fait principalement par télétravail mais des rencontres occasionnelles à nos bureaux sont possibles.

Ton profil :

  • Tu as d’excellentes capacités d’analyse et un souci de documenter adéquatement les requis fonctionnels?

  • Tu es motivé par le besoin de donner du sens à ce que tu fais

  • Tu aimes améliorer constamment les processus de développement en mode Agile?

  • Tu aimes le télétravail pour ton équilibre travail-famille?

Tes responsabilités, plus en détails :

  • Produire des documents d’analyse fonctionnelle détaillés, clairs et structurés, servant de base aux équipes de développement (produits, logiciels ou projets)

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, les architectes de solutions et les parties prenantes pour assurer la cohérence entre les besoins métiers et les livrables techniques

  • Participer à la définition des exigences, des cas d’usage et des scénarios fonctionnels

  • Valider et documenter les changements requis par nos clients

  • Collaborer activement à l’évolution et à la maintenance de la plateforme

  • Participer aux analyses de faisabilité et à la rédaction des spécifications nécessaires

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe de contrôle de la qualité et contribuer aux tests fonctionnels et intégrés

Ton expertise et tes compétences :

  • Diplôme de niveau collégial ou supérieur en informatique

  • 4 à 6 ans d’expérience pertinente dans le secteur

  • Posséder un fort esprit analytique

  • Posséder une excellente capacité de communication et de documentation

Atouts :

  • Expérience avec le domaine de l’immobilier

  • Notions de comptabilité ou de gestion

  • Expérience avec Azure DevOps

  • Connaissance de la méthodologie Agile

  • Capacité à lire du code existant (Delphi, C#)

  • Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise car le titulaire du poste aura à communiquer fréquemment dans les deux langues, tant oralement que par écrit. Nous avons des collègues, des clients et des partenaires au Québec, ainsi que dans le reste du Canada et aux États-Unis.

Les avantages offerts :

  • D’excellents avantages sociaux (dentaire, optométrie, médical, programme vie active de 325$ annuellement, programme REER, programme d’aide aux employés, programme d’achat d’actions)

  • Du télétravail presque 100% de ton temps

  • Des collègues en or, de bonnes relations, de l’entraide et de l’esprit d’équipe.

  • De la reconnaissance sous toutes ses formes.

  • Des possibilités d’évolution et d’avancement.

  • Des options pour mieux concilier vie personnelle et travail (complément maternité pour les 6 premières semaines, congés personnels, journée de bénévolat).

  • Et surtout, des fous rires au quotidien!

Tes coéquipiers :

Ton gestionnaire sera Martin, c’est lui qui dirige l’équipe R&D. Il valorise la collaboration, il aime s’entourer d’experts, donne beaucoup de latitude à son équipe et est à l’écoute des idées nouvelles pour faire avancer les choses. 

Tu travailleras aussi en étroite collaboration avec Caroline, chef d’équipe, Danielle, analyste sénior, et Hugo, chef de produit en immobilier ainsi que toute l’équipe élargie, qui ont déjà hâte de t’accueillir. 

Notre entreprise :

L’ouverture, c’est ce qui nous représente chez HOPEM : l’ouverture à ton unicité, à tes intérêts, à ta réalité et sans oublier, aux fous rires!

Chez HOPEM, nous créons des logiciels qui facilitent la gestion des propriétés locatives québécoises afin que nos clients puissent se concentrer sur leur croissance. Notre mission : accompagner nos clients en développant des outils de gestion performants!

Le processus de sélection :

Pour appliquer, tu dois d’abord compléter ton profil dans notre système Workday. Ensuite, nous procéderons à l’entrevue en ligne ou en présentiel. Finalement il y aura une prise de références et une vérification des antécédents.

Si tu as un intérêt pour livrer des analyses détaillées et bien documentées, que tu recherches le monde idéal entre la grosse boîte et la PME et que faire évoluer des logiciels vers les nouvelles technos te parle, ce rôle au sein de notre équipe est le défi que tu attendais!

Nous sommes prêts à t’ouvrir notre porte! L’ouvriras-tu?

Martin Lavallée

Directeur Senior R&D

*Seul les candidats retenus seront contactés*

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et les candidatures des membres des groupes visés à savoir les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les personnes autochtones et les minorités visibles sont encouragées à soumettre leur candidature. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L'équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris n'a pas recours aux messages texte pour entrer en communication avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler sur des postes publiés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe de recrutement de talents pour un entretien, dès lors que les critères requis sont satisfaits.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly skilled Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer to join our growing team. This is a hands-on technical role focused on designing, building, and optimizing Workfront Fusion automations, integrations, and workflows that support enterprise-scale marketing and operational processes.

This is not a strategy-only or advisory position. We're seeking an engineer who enjoys solving complex integration challenges, building scalable automation solutions, and working directly within the Workfront Fusion platform.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations using Adobe Workfront Fusion.
  • Develop scalable automation workflows that connect Workfront with other business platforms and applications.
  • Collaborate with architects, consultants, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve integration and automation issues.
  • Implement best practices around data flow design, error handling, logging, monitoring, and exception management.
  • Build technical documentation, demos, and knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Support continuous improvements to enterprise workflows and integration processes.
  • Stay current with the latest Adobe Workfront Fusion capabilities, features, and best practices.
