We're excited about the potential people bring to our organization. You can grow your career here while enjoying first-class perks, benefits and a culture that fosters growth, innovation and collaboration.

Overview

The Case Manager will be responsible for applying the six essential activities of case management which include assessment, planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation with the core components through the administration of quality improvement functions (process, relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery and psychosocial intervention).

Qualifications

  • Registered Nurse (RN) with active, current, unrestricted license in a Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) state required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Case Management Certification (CCM) required. Candidates without CCM certification are required to obtain it within three (3) years of commencing employment.
  • Three (3) years of clinical RN experience in a med/surg or ambulatory care setting required. Clinical experience in at least one of the following areas preferred: Behavior Health, Transplant, Neo-Natal or Oncology.
  • Previous experience in managed care a plus.
  • Clinical knowledge of the health or social work needs for the population served.
  • Ability to identify barriers to a successful care management path.
  • Ability to interact effectively with physicians and other members of the health care team.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, coupled with solid time management skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Transferable knowledge, skill and ability to complete job duties independently and proficiently. Flexibility in work schedules and assignments.
  • Proven examples of displaying Nova’s Core 4: Act with Passion, Work Together, Be Accountable, Build Trust.

Essential Accountabilities

  • Assess the patient’s broad spectrum of immediate and long-term needs through evaluation of the patient’s social and medical history.
  • Develop a plan of care based upon the patient and providers of care clinical assessments, considering physical and psychosocial needs, the benefit plan and cost benefit analysis factors which impact the patient’s optimal recovery.
  • Continuously evaluate the plan of care within the scope of case management practice based on the changing needs of the patient and monitor the quality of care and effectiveness of care being provided for all involved members of the inter disciplinary team.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and privacy standards, prompt payment/reimbursement and appeal process as indicated; coordinate the decision and documentation process; maintain a current and accurate database.
  • Establish professional working relationships with all members of the interdisciplinary team and communicate case objectives to the appropriate involved parties.
  • Act as a patient advocate understanding and identifying potential for complications, understanding methods for assessing the current and future physical and psychosocial characteristics of illnesses.
  • Read, understand and apply principals of the American with Disabilities Act and understand federal legislation affecting individuals with disabilities.
  • Be knowledgeable of assistive and adaptive equipment.
  • Establish available support systems and be versed in methods of researching and interviewing community resources to assist the patient in achieving maximum psychological, social and physical recovery.
  • Effectively communicate to the patient the available services and resources applicable to the patient’s immediate and future needs. Assist the patient in obtaining these services.
  • Identify cases that would benefit from alternative care through assessment and evaluation of the patient’s needs, as well as available resources.
  • Work closely with the payor, providers and all involved team members in evaluating the quality and cost effectiveness of services. Negotiate cost discounts when appropriate.
  • Identify cases that would benefit from alternative levels of care and resources (i.e. rehabilitation facilities and home health care providers). Implement alternatives to existing care, considering quality of care and the patient’s current and ongoing needs.
  • Understand case management concepts such as roles, philosophies, principles, liability and confidentiality issues. Apply these concepts in developing appropriate plan of care and goals based on the needs of the patient.
  • Be knowledgeable in applying problem solving techniques to the case management process. Analyze and evaluate outcomes and implement alternatives when appropriate.
  • Document the patient’s plan of care in a timely manner.
  • Maintain professional status within the community through membership in professional organizations and/or participation in continuing education.
  • Participate in Nova’s training and education committees as assigned. Provide input into support staff orientation and training as it relates to the Case Manager’s role.
  • Provide support, guidance, and direction to support staff as indicated.
  • Perform all assignments in a professional manner.
  • Be knowledgeable of the scope of practice of their multi-state licensure and practice accordingly.

Immigration or work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this position

Hiring Compensation Range: $35.50 - $38.00 hourly

Compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to skills, education, location and experience.


In addition to base compensation, associates may be eligible for a scorecard incentive, full range of benefits and generous paid time off. The base salary range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Project Manager Signage

What this job involves:

JLL is seeking an Interior Signage & Rebranding Project Manager to oversee the successful delivery of interior signage and workplace rebranding projects across commercial office environments. In this role, you will manage the full project lifecycle from design handoff through fabrication, installation, and project closeout, serving as a critical quality control partner across design, fabrication, construction, and site operations teams. This position requires a detail-oriented project manager who is comfortable balancing multiple concurrent schedules while maintaining a strong focus on technical accuracy, stakeholder coordination, and field execution.

At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees — and this role plays an important part in delivering high-quality workplace experiences that reflect our clients’ evolving brands and environments.   • Manage project closeout activities, including warranty documentation, final records, and coordination of decommissioning or patch-and-paint scope as required.

This role serves as the senior technical contributor for CRM application development, integrations, customizations, and platform extensibility supporting store operations, contact center sales and service teams, eCommerce customer engagement, and AI-powered customer interactions. The Senior Dynamics 365 CRM Developer will lead the design and review of source code, custom applications, integrations, APIs, automations, chatbot solutions, and platform enhancements while ensuring scalability, security, maintainability, and alignment with Mattress Firm's modern technology architecture.     • Monitor chatbot performance and identify optimization opportunities using customer interaction analytics.

raw.excerpt: About WingWing is one of the world's largest virtual talent companies, venture-backed and based in San Francisco.
raw.description:
About Wing

Wing is one of the world's largest virtual talent companies, venture-backed and based in San Francisco. Leveraging our scale, millions of applicants, and operational expertise, we’re expanding into next-generation AI products. Across both parts of our business, we help businesses automate their workflows, scale their operations, and leverage top global talent.
We’re now building an in-house video content engine to showcase our products, educate SMBs, and create engaging, high-quality content across YouTube, TikTok, paid ads, landing pages, and more.

About the Role

We are hiring a full-time Content Creator & On-Camera Talent to produce compelling product walkthroughs, educational videos, thought-leadership content, UGC-style ads, and industry-specific explainers for our company.
You will film yourself & your screen regularly, create scripts, edit videos, record your screen while on camera, collaborate on creative concepts, and produce 3–5 videos per week across multiple formats. You’ll work closely with our marketing and product teams. You will have a lot of autonomy to suggest content and have a high degree of impact.
This is a highly creative, high-leverage role that will directly shape our company's (and sister brands') public identity. In short, you will have a ton of impact in this role.

Responsibilities

Content Production
  • Film yourself on camera for short-form and long-form video content (YouTube, TikTok, Facebook/Instagram, LinkedIn, product pages, ads).
  • Produce multiple polished videos per week, including: Product tutorials & walkthroughs; Explainer videos for SMBs across multiple industries (law firms, HVAC, real estate, med spa, home services, etc.); UGC-style testimonial ads for paid performance channels; Sales enablement content: objection handling, use-case stories, etc; How-to and onboarding videos for customers; Thought leadership, commentary, and trend breakdowns.
Scriptwriting & Creative Development
  • Write clear, engaging scripts and hooks.
  • Brainstorm video ideas aligned with business goals and trending content formats.
  • Localize content to feel authentically American in tone, delivery, and cultural reference.
Video Editing & Post-Production
  • Edit videos for multiple platforms using tools like CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, or similar.
  • Add subtitles, transitions, animations, screen recordings, and visual overlays.
  • Maintain consistent branding (music, colors, lower thirds, CTA styles).
Technical Setup
  • Handle basic filming setup: lighting, framing, mic checks, stable camera use.
  • Willing to learn more advanced techniques for cleaner, more polished production.
Tools & Tech
  • Use apps like Zapier, Make, n8n, Slack, and others to show off product automations.
  • Be tech-savvy enough to learn new tools (B2B tools like CRMs, Dialers, etc.) quickly.
Collaboration & Operations
  • Work with marketing, product, and sales to align content with campaigns.
  • Join occasional on-location shoots with clients or internal teams.

Requirements

Must-Haves
  • Strong camera presence with a confident, friendly, and clear speaking voice.
  • Clear and fluent spoken English that US based customers can easily understand.
  • Comfortable filming yourself regularly and following scripts.
  • Experience editing videos (short-form or long-form).
  • Strong familiarity with social media platforms (YT, TikTok, Reels).
  • Tech-savvy - able to learn software tools quickly (CRMs, Zapier/, phone systems, automations, etc.).
  • Proactive, organized, and able to consistently hit weekly content output goals.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Background in content creation, influencing, livestreaming, UGC, or on-camera work.
  • Interest in AI, tech, startups, or business automation.
  • Experience writing scripts or storyboards.
  • Familiarity with lighting setups, microphones, cameras.
  • Understanding of U.S. culture, humor, and SMB pain points.
  • Understanding of cameras, lighting, coloring - know how to adjust complex settings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary for top talent (ZAR 20,000–43,000 monthly, depending on skills & communication ability).
  • Performance-based bonuses.
  • A long-term full-time career with huge growth potential & impact.
  • Work with a global team across the world.

About DEUNA 🧡
We are a rapidly growing startup that simplifies global payments and powers next generation commerce in a single platform. With our products we've consolidated hundreds of payment solutions in a single integration, harness an intuitive payment orchestration method and centralize payment reconciliation.
We are currently present all across LATAM and looking for exceptional talent to join our team and continue revolutionizing the world of payments! 🚀
Visit to learn more about us!

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Technical Monitoring Analyst to ensure the continuous reliability, stability, and performance of DEUNA’s payment platform. In this mission-critical role, you will be the first line of defense for detecting system anomalies, managing real-time alerts, and executing initial incident triage to support business continuity for our merchants. You will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, and Customer Support teams to maintain optimal uptime in a fast-paced, high-availability payments environment.

Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in Operations Monitoring, Technical Support, or NOC roles, within online payment systems or fintech environments.

  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Grafana, Rootly, Opsgenie) and ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira).

  • Proven ability to perform initial incident triage, runbook execution, log reviews, and basic metric analysis.

  • Basic understanding of APIs, request/response cycles, web application workflows, and querying data using simple SQL.

  • Familiarity with log management solutions (AWS CloudWatch, Splunk) and testing tools (Postman).

  • English Proficiency (A2–B1 minimum): Ability to read technical documentation, update tickets, log findings, and communicate clearly during incidents.

  • Comfortable working in a 24/7 rotating shift environment and participating in on-call schedules.

Mindset

  • High Attention to Detail: Catches minor anomalies before they turn into major outages.

  • Calm Under Pressure: Maintains clarity, composure, and speed during critical operational incidents.

  • Process & Execution-Driven: Meticulously follows runbooks, checklists, and escalation pathways.

  • Continuous Learner: Fast to adopt new technologies, internal tools, and operational procedures while actively improving English skills.

  • Strong Ownership: Takes pride in maintaining system uptime and supporting seamless merchant experiences.

What You'll Do

  • Continuously monitor platform infrastructure, application health, and transactional payment flows to identify alerts and anomalies.

  • Triage incoming incidents (via Rootly, Opsgenie, etc.), classify severity levels (S0–S2), and execute initial troubleshooting steps (log reviews, metric analysis).

  • Accurately escalate unresolved issues to advanced technical teams, providing actionable context, initial impact assessments, logs, and screenshots.

  • Execute functional tests across merchant environments (checkout flows, payment integrations) in Production, Staging, and Sandbox environments.

  • Support deployment activities by executing predefined pre- and post-deployment operational validation checklists.

  • Manage operational support tickets and communication via Zendesk and Jira, keeping internal stakeholders updated during active incidents.

  • Perform routine merchant operational configurations (payment method settings, parameter adjustments, and recurring tasks).

  • Document incidents, investigations, and findings clearly to improve internal runbooks and maintain high reporting standards.

  • Track key operational KPIs, including MTTD (Mean Time to Detect), Escalation Response Time, and SLA compliance.

Requirements

  • Payments Domain Knowledge: 1–3 years of experience monitoring or supporting online payment gateways, payment service providers (PSPs), checkout flows, or digital transaction processing.

  • Operations Experience: Background in NOC, Technical Support, or Operational Monitoring environments.

  • Monitoring & Ticketing Tools: Experience with Grafana, Rootly, Opsgenie, Jira, and Zendesk (or equivalent platforms).

  • Technical Fundamentals: Familiarity with API request/response flows, log analysis tools (AWS CloudWatch, Splunk), basic Postman, and simple SQL queries.

  • Incident Triage: Ability to execute runbooks, analyze basic logs, triage alerts, and classify severity levels.

  • Language Skills: B1 English proficiency or above (reading technical docs, updating tickets, and written incident communication).

  • Shift Availability: Flexibility to work in a 24/7 rotating shift model and participate in on-call schedules.

What will you find when you join DEUNA?

- A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM
- Dynamism, agility and constant innovation
- Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region
- The best tools and technology to operate
- Being part of the startup culture.

Remote work from anywhere 💻

We all own DEUNA, we offer stock options 💸
Multidisciplinary, diverse and dynamic team 🧡
Growth and career path 🚀
Be part of a dynamic team that's creating the next generation payments platform.

Join us at DEUNA!

Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking an experienced Mobile Apps Software Product Management Lead to drive the vision, strategy, modernization, sustainment, and delivery of mobile applications supporting Military OneSource and the MODES III mission. The lead will oversee the My Military OneSource, Chill Drills, Mil Provider, and future mobile products and guide secure, accessible, reliable delivery across Apple iOS and Google Android ecosystems.

This leader will translate the needs of Service Members, military families, providers, government stakeholders, and program partners into measurable product outcomes while directing cross-functional mobile engineering, UX, testing, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, analytics, and operations activities.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Vision, Portfolio Strategy, and Roadmap

  • Define and execute product vision, goals, outcome-based roadmaps, and lifecycle strategies for the My Military OneSource, Chill Drills, and Mil Provider applications.
  • Align mobile product priorities with mission objectives, user needs, contract requirements, platform policies, technical feasibility, accessibility, privacy, cybersecurity, and available resources.
  • Use adoption, engagement, task completion, reliability, crash, performance, accessibility, app-store, and user-feedback data to prioritize investments and continuous improvement.
  • Manage product maturity across new features, modernization, sustainment, technical debt, platform upgrades, defect remediation, and retirement decisions.

Stakeholder and User Leadership

  • Collaborate with government product owners, mission leaders, communications teams, Service Members, military families, providers, business analysts, UX researchers, designers, architects, engineers, testers, cybersecurity personnel, and operations teams.
  • Translate mission and policy needs into product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release objectives, and measurable success indicators.
  • Facilitate discovery, user research, prototype reviews, roadmap reviews, demonstrations, governance discussions, and executive decision briefings.
  • Champion human-centered and inclusive design for users operating across varied devices, connectivity conditions, abilities, and levels of technical proficiency.

Mobile Product and Platform Leadership

  • Lead cross-platform and native mobile delivery for iOS and Android, including application architecture, device capabilities, responsive/adaptive interfaces, offline behavior, notifications, deep linking, authentication, analytics, and backend integrations.
  • Guide technology decisions involving native iOS development with Swift and SwiftUI; native Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose; and cross-platform development with React Native, Flutter/Dart, Kotlin Multiplatform, Ionic, or Capacitor when appropriate.
  • Ensure product decisions account for Apple App Store and Google Play submission, signing, provisioning, review, release-track, privacy-disclosure, compatibility, and update requirements.
  • Coordinate mobile API, identity, content, data, search, messaging, and cloud-service integrations while promoting modular, maintainable, testable, and API-enabled designs.

Agile Product Delivery and Release Management

  • Own and prioritize product backlogs and ensure work is ready for discovery, design, refinement, development, testing, security review, release, acceptance, and operations.
  • Lead release planning, sprint and increment objectives, dependency management, risk resolution, beta and pilot activities, phased rollout, rollback planning, and stakeholder communications.
  • Coordinate mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, code signing, testing, security scanning, artifact management, environment promotion, and app-store deployment.
  • Validate delivered capabilities against acceptance criteria and mission outcomes and coordinate user acceptance with government stakeholders.

Mobile Engineering, Quality, and Innovation

  • Guide teams working with Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, Dart, JavaScript/TypeScript, React Native, Flutter, REST/JSON APIs, GraphQL, SQL, and cloud-native backend services.
  • Promote mobile architecture and design patterns such as MVVM, unidirectional data flow, modularization, dependency injection, state management, secure local storage, caching, and resilient networking.
  • Ensure comprehensive unit, integration, UI, contract, accessibility, security, compatibility, and performance testing using emulators, simulators, physical devices, and automated test tooling.
  • Evaluate responsible uses of on-device AI/ML, generative AI, personalization, natural-language interfaces, automation, and analytics while maintaining human oversight, privacy, security, transparency, and mission value.
  • Evaluate low-code/no-code mobile options when appropriate without compromising platform capability, maintainability, cybersecurity, accessibility, or long-term ownership.

Cybersecurity, Privacy, Accessibility, Quality, and Operations

  • Integrate secure mobile development, privacy, records management, Section 508 accessibility, reliability, performance, observability, and operational readiness into product decisions and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate product priorities supporting RMF, NIST SP 800-53 controls, Zero Trust principles, Authority to Operate activities, vulnerability remediation, software supply-chain risk, and secure API and identity practices.
  • Use OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard and Mobile Application Security Testing Guide concepts to establish mobile security and privacy expectations and verification activities.
  • Apply ITIL practices to incident, problem, change, release, service request, knowledge, and continual improvement activities affecting mobile products.
  • Ensure release notes, support documentation, training, knowledge transfer, analytics, monitoring, crash reporting, and operational playbooks are complete for product changes.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

Education (Required)

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Product Management, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered when permitted by contract requirements.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in software product management, product ownership, digital product delivery, or technology leadership.
  • Experience leading product vision, roadmaps, feature strategies, backlogs, releases, and user-focused requirements for native or cross-platform mobile applications.
  • Demonstrated experience managing mobile products across discovery, design, development, testing, app-store release, analytics, sustainment, and modernization.
  • Experience leading Agile cross-functional teams in complex federal, DoD, public-sector, healthcare, human services, or similarly regulated environments.
  • Experience collaborating with government stakeholders and translating mission and policy needs into actionable mobile software outcomes.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of iOS and Android product ecosystems, mobile application lifecycles, device constraints, platform design conventions, app-store delivery, and mobile release management.
  • Working knowledge of native mobile technologies including Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, Objective-C, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Studio, Java, Gradle, and platform SDKs.
  • Working knowledge of cross-platform technologies such as React Native with JavaScript/TypeScript, Flutter with Dart, Kotlin Multiplatform, Ionic, or Capacitor.
  • Understanding of mobile architecture, API integration, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, secure local storage, offline synchronization, push notifications, deep links, analytics, crash reporting, and performance optimization.
  • Experience overseeing Git-based source control, pull requests, automated testing, mobile CI/CD, code signing, dependency management, software composition analysis, and staged releases.
  • Understanding of mobile usability and accessibility, including platform accessibility APIs, assistive technology testing, responsive/adaptive layouts, and Section 508 considerations.
  • Understanding of secure mobile design and testing, including data protection, cryptography and key management, authentication, network security, platform interaction, privacy, code quality, resilience, and software supply-chain risks.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management, sprint planning, release management, and end-to-end software development lifecycles.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL practices supporting digital product operations.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with open-source mobile frameworks and tooling such as React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Ionic, Capacitor, Fastlane, Appium, Detox, Maestro, or similar solutions.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native mobile backends in AWS GovCloud or Microsoft Azure Government, including APIs, serverless functions, containers, managed databases, identity, messaging, content delivery, observability, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience supporting regulated IL4/IL5 environments and integrating mobile products with federal identity, security, monitoring, and enterprise services.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, or similar product and engineering collaboration tools.
  • Experience with human-centered design, mobile usability research, prototypes, design systems, accessibility testing, product analytics, feature flags, experimentation, and phased rollout.
  • Experience with on-device ML, privacy-preserving analytics, generative AI integrations, mobile threat modeling, penetration testing, and secure coding reviews.
  • Experience supporting high-availability, public-sector, multilingual, offline-capable, or high-traffic consumer mobile products.

Certifications

  • Required: ITIL 4 Foundation.
  • Required: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or comparable product owner certification.
  • Required: CompTIA Security+ or approved equivalent.
  • Preferred: PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), Project Management Professional (PMP), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or additional product management certifications.
  • Preferred: AWS, Azure, mobile development, accessibility, cybersecurity, secure software, Agile, or DevSecOps certifications.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate mission needs and mobile user journeys into clear business, user, technical, security, and accessibility requirements.
  • Excellent prioritization, decision-making, analytical, risk-management, and problem-solving abilities.

Contribuer activement au développement commercial du cabinet en identifiant des cibles pertinentes, en structurant les actions de prospection et en assurant le suivi opérationnel des démarches commerciales.

Responsabilités

• Ciblage de prospects :

• Analyse et segmentation de sociétés par secteur, taille, activité et enjeux fiscaux potentiels.

• Constitution et mise à jour de bases de données prospects.

• Prospection & développement commercial :

• Préparation et envoi de contenus commerciaux (emails, notes, présentations).

• Participation à la mise en place de campagnes de prospection.

• Préparation des supports pour les rendez-vous (briefs, fiches sociétés).

• Suivi commercial :

• Suivi des relances, gestion du pipeline commercial, mise à jour du CRM (ou tableur).

• Reporting régulier sur l’avancée des actions et les résultats.

• Veille sectorielle et concurrentielle :

• Identification des opportunités (secteurs en mouvement, évolutions réglementaires).

• Benchmark de cabinets concurrents ou acteurs du marché

Nous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) motivé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome, doté(e) d’une excellente capacité d’analyse et d’une aisance tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. Un intérêt marqué pour le droit fiscal, le conseil ou le développement commercial sera un atout, tout comme la maîtrise d’Excel ou Google Sheets (la connaissance d’un CRM est un plus).

Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en école de commerce (licence ou master), avec un sens du service, de la réactivité et un goût prononcé pour les missions opérationnelles.
Durée du stage : à définir, entre 3 et 6 mois selon disponibilité.

Avantages :

  • Forfait mobilité durable pour accompagner vos déplacements domicile-travail selon vos besoins,
  • Environnement de travail attractif et tout confort. Dès 2025, un nouveau Campus à Levallois (5 min à pied du métro) : salle de sport, espaces verts, roof top, terrasses, restauration, conciergerie…
  • CSE (offre sportive, cinéma, art et culture, cadeaux de fin d’année, soirée annuelle, etc…),
  • Mutuelle modulable selon vos besoins
  • Association sportive (groupes de running, foot, basket, golf, tennis, ou encore yoga, etc….)
  • PC portable, double écran et Iphone

Déroulé du processus de recrutement :

Andy est en charge de ce recrutement, elle sera votre point de contact tout au long de votre process.

Une fois votre candidature envoyée, vous recevrez un test de compétences à réaliser afin de finaliser votre candidature. Une réponse sera envoyée sous 1 à 4 semaines.

Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous serez contacté(e) pour participer au processus suivant : deux entretiens de 45 minutes pour démontrer vos motivations.

Vous serez contacté(e) à l’issue des deux entretiens sous une semaine afin de connaitre le retour définitif quant à votre candidature.

Si vous souhaitez construire votre propre parcours et que vous aimez entreprendre, vous êtes au bon endroit !

At Advertise Purple, we’ve built a culture based on collaboration, ambition, and accountability – but most importantly we like being around good people. We’re looking for people who choose to show up with the right attitude, and put in the effort to make an impact in order to help us take Advertise Purple to the next level!

The Director of Social Commerce will lead Advertise Purple’s TikTok Shop division and be responsible for growing our clients’ TikTok Shop programs. This person will own the strategic direction of the division, manage and develop the Social Commerce team, serve as the senior client-facing liaison for Advertise Purple, and oversee the technical and third-party integrations required to operate and scale successful programs. The Director will develop and oversee strategies designed to drive sustainable growth across the TikTok Shop ecosystem, leveraging opportunities including GMV Max, TikTok LIVE, Creator Contests, our creator Discord community, creator affiliate programs, and third-party platforms.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead Advertise Purple’s TikTok Shop division, owning client strategy, growth, execution, and overall program performance
  • Develop and direct TikTok Shop strategies focused on increasing GMV and building sustainable client growth
  • Serve as the primary senior client-facing liaison, communicating strategy, performance, opportunities, and challenges
  • Manage, mentor, and develop the Social Commerce team while establishing clear goals, processes, and performance expectations
  • Identify and activate growth opportunities across the TikTok Shop ecosystem, including GMV Max, LIVE, Creator Contests, and creator affiliate programs
  • Oversee technical integrations and program infrastructure, including TikTok Shop, Shopify, Cruva, Euka, and other third-party platforms
  • Monitor client performance and translate data and trends into actionable strategic recommendations
  • Iterate on existing department processes and best practices, identifying opportunities to improve how the team operates and scales

What You Have:

  • BA/BS degree from an accredited university
  • Experience managing, mentoring, and developing a team
  • Demonstrated experience managing and growing TikTok Shop programs
  • Deep understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and the strategies required to successfully scale brands on the platform
  • Strong understanding of the technical integrations and operational infrastructure required to run successful TikTok Shops
  • Proven client-facing experience with the ability to communicate strategy and performance to key stakeholders
  • Familiarity with third-party TikTok Shop tools such as Cruva and Euka and e-commerce platforms such as Shopify
  • Strong understanding of TikTok Shop growth levers, including GMV Max, TikTok LIVE, Creator Contests, and creator affiliate programs
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to take ownership of a growing business function

What We Offer:

  • 100% paid employer-paid benefits (health, dental, vision, and life insurance)
  • 401k match up to 6%
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Mental Health Days
  • Flexible Fridays from January to October (offline at 2:00 PM)

About Advertise Purple

Advertise Purple, Inc., the recipient of the 2021 Rakuten OPM/Agency of the Year and the prestigious 2023 Sammy Award, is the leading management agency in today’s fastest-growing digital marketing channel for e-commerce retailers: affiliate. With a $6 billion addressable market, and estimated 20 million e-commerce stores, our award-winning suite of technology and service tools are well-positioned to serve the growing global demand.

Advertise Purple continues to lead the way, securing a spot on Inc Magazine's Fastest Growing Companies list for an impressive six consecutive years. We're also honored to have been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the 'Best Workplaces in the U.S.' and as a 'Top 50 Advertising & Marketing Agency in the U.S.' These accolades reflect our unwavering commitment to providing an exceptional experience for both our clients and employees, making us a standout in the industry.

We believe that diversity benefits enhance everyone's development at Advertise Purple. Our goal is to attract, develop, and retain the best and brightest from diverse backgrounds and all walks of life. This requires our organization to cultivate an inclusive culture in which all employees feel valued, are treated fairly, have a work-life balance, and have the opportunity to be successful at Advertise Purple.

Remote Licensed Insurance Customer Service Representative

Work From Home | Full Time | US

Build a career in insurance, from the comfort of home

What if your next career move came with paid licensing, full benefits, and real room to grow, all without leaving your house? At Foundever, we invest in you from day one so you can build something lasting in the insurance industry.

About This Role

Have you ever thought about becoming a licensed insurance professional? This is your opportunity.

As a Work From Home Licensed Insurance Customer Service Representative, you will handle inbound calls supporting customers across Auto, Homeowners, Renters, and Umbrella insurance policies. Your focus will be delivering accurate, empathetic service while helping customers understand their coverage and resolve policy questions with confidence.

This role is about education, not pressure. You will offer thoughtful, needs based coverage recommendations that genuinely fit each customer's situation.

Here is how you get started: While completing your licensing requirements, you will begin by supporting billing inquiries. Once licensed, you transition into full policy servicing and coverage support. Foundever covers every step of the licensing journey including pre-licensing preparation, exam fees, and background checks.

To set yourself up for success, you will need a quiet, dedicated workspace at home where you can stay focused during training and customer calls.

Why Foundever

  • $16 to $19 per hour based on training phase and production milestones
  • 100% paid professional training starting at $16 per hour
  • Foundever covers your licensing costs including prep, testing, and fees
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off and employee discounts
  • Bonus programs and referral incentives
  • 93% of managers promoted internally because growth here is real

What We’re Looking For

  • 18 years or older with a high school diploma or GED
  • 1 year of customer service or related experience preferred
  • Comfortable managing inbound calls in a structured, work from home environment
  • Open availability including evenings and weekends based on business needs
  • Commitment to consistent attendance during training and your assigned schedule after successful completion is key. Your engagement, attendance, and performance throughout training help us match you with the best available production schedule for success.
  • Motivated to complete coursework and earn your state insurance license

Skills That Set You Up for Success

  • Ability to navigate multiple systems and tools with ease
  • Clear, professional communication with customers and teammates
  • Confidence explaining insurance coverage options with empathy
  • Strong self motivation, accountability, and attention to detail
  • Ability to identify customer needs and recommend the right solutions

Your Home Office Setup

To do your best work, you will need:

  • A hardwired high speed internet connection with a minimum of 20 Mbps upload and download
  • A quiet, secure, and dedicated workspace free from distractions
  • A webcam is provided and will be used throughout training to create an engaging, connected learning experience. Once you are in your role, you can expect to use it for team check ins, one on ones, and team activities as well.
  • A personal computer, laptop, or compatible tablet during College of Insurance training

Licensing Requirements

Foundever covers everything you need to get licensed including pre-licensing training and exam prep, testing and licensing fees, and required background checks.

Please note that travel to testing or fingerprinting locations may be required, and a valid state issued photo ID is needed to complete this process.

Schedule and Training Hours

Hours of Operation

  • Monday through Friday: 8 a.m.-10 p.m. ET (7 a.m.-9 p.m. CT)
  • Saturday: 8 a.m.-8 p.m. ET (7 a.m.-7 p.m. CT)
  • Sunday: 11 a.m.-5 p.m. ET (10 a.m.-4 p.m. CT)

Shifts may include evenings and weekends. All shifts are scheduled within our hours of operation, and schedules are shared in advance so you can plan accordingly.

Training Schedule

  • College of Insurance (COI) Training: Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-5:30 p.m. ET (8 a.m.-4:30 p.m. CT)
  • Product Training: Monday-Friday, 11:30 a.m.-8 p.m. ET (10:30 a.m.-7 p.m. CT)

Who Thrives Here

People who enjoy structured learning, helping others make sense of complex information, and building a stable work from home career with real growth ahead. If that sounds like you, we would love to connect.

Foundever celebrates the moments that matter, and your career is one of them.

About Foundever

Foundever is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 130,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.

Supporting +9 million customer conversations every day in +60 languages across 45 countries, Foundever combines global strength and scale with the agile, entrepreneurial approach of our founder-led culture, enabling companies of all sizes and industries to transform their CX.

Military Partners 

We proudly support military families through partnerships with Military One Source and other veteran organizations. We value the unique skills and experiences that veterans bring to our workforce.

Our employees are experts in the employee experience, workforce communications and technology.
Joining Firstup means joining a movement to make work better for every worker. As the world’s first intelligent communication platform, Firstup meaningfully engages employees at every moment from hire to retire, and delivers engagement insights to help companies support, promote and retain their talent. Our movement has taken root and is evident in our world-class customer base. Now we need your help. Ready to make a difference in the world?

Job Summary

The Sr. Software Engineer will join the team responsible for Firstup's public APIs, Agentic tools, third-party integrations with enterprise systems such as HRIS platforms, and shared platform services. You will deliver innovative, scalable solutions while constantly improving our approach to architecture, scale, availability, and fault-tolerance. You are an active user of Generative AI tools and coding agents, applying them daily to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of public-facing APIs used by enterprise customers.

  • Build and maintain integrations with external enterprise systems, including HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, and Dayforce.

  • Support shared platform services used across the engineering organisation.

  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code, and participate in code reviews.

  • Work within large-scale multi-tenant cloud services, developing your understanding of scalability and fault-tolerance.

  • Use Generative AI tools and coding agents in day-to-day workflows to improve code quality and delivery speed.

  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional partners to solve problems and deliver customer value.

  • Contribute to production health, including on-call rotations and incident response, in a "you build it, you run it" environment.

  • Identify and help resolve availability, reliability, and performance issues.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 3-5 years building reliable, performant applications and microservices.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js. Ruby experience is a plus.

  • Experience across frontend (React.js), backend, and database layers.

  • AWS experience, including core compute, storage, and networking services.

  • Curiosity, a desire to learn, and openness to feedback.

  • A focus on customer experience in the work you deliver.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with HRIS integrations, such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Dayforce, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm.

  • Familiarity with Datadog or similar observability and monitoring platforms.

  • Demonstrated use of Generative AI tools or coding agents in development workflows.

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS organisations.

  • Open-source contributions or a history of side projects.

Why Firstup?

Because you care - about people, the work you do, and the connections you make. Work is such a large part of life; it only makes sense to make it awesome.
If you want to engage brilliant minds in a high-growth and inclusive environment where ideas are rewarded regardless of who they come from, join us. This is a rapidly changing space so if you thrive on ambiguity, are hungry for a challenge, and have the guts to speak your mind, you could be a perfect fit.
We offer an excellent PTO program, great health benefits, a casual and friendly environment, remote work, and a leadership team who truly believes in your growth – both personally and professionally.

Actuarial Analyst

Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!

As an Actuarial Analyst, you will drive data-informed decisions by conducting advanced statistical analyses to support pricing in your assigned region and products. You'll collaborate closely with the regional pricing actuary, underwriting, and product teams to develop innovative pricing strategies that balance profitability with market competitiveness. You will work on the rate impact team assisting with policy re-rating, impact metrics, and state pricing scenarios.

What you’ll do

  • Assist the pricing actuary in your region with rate studies, rate indications, filing support, policy re-rating, and impacts
  • Prepare and reconcile data
  • Conduct preliminary analysis of data and reports and review internally
  • Conduct ad hoc reports
  • Assist on project tasks

This might describe you

  • Skilled in mathematical and statistical procedures
  • Excellent ability to analyze various forms of statistical data
  • Good oral and written communication skills
  • Good working knowledge of coding/statistical software such as Excel, SQL, SAS, R, Python, etc.
  • 1 - 2 years of actuarial or related analytics experience
  • Experience with pricing tools such as Radar or Akur8
  • Experience in re-rating and validating premiums

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • This role will not be eligible for the exam program
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable

Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is an automotive enthusiast brand and the world’s largest membership organization. Along with being a best-in-class provider of specialty insurance for enthusiasts, Hagerty is also home to the Hagerty Drivers Foundation, Garage + Social, Hagerty Drivers Club, Marketplace and so much more. Committed to saving driving for future generations, each and every thing Hagerty does is dedicated to the love of the automobile.

Hagerty is a rapidly growing company that values a winning culture. We provide meaningful work for and invest in every single team member.

At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference. We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights‑driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient‑focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry‑leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Clinical Trial Manager (SCTM) to join our team in a remote capacity in South Africa. As a SCTM, you will act as a member of the sponsor’s Development Operations team and will manage individual clinical trials and/or programs as part of their Clinical Trial Working Group.

You’ll join a fast‑paced, growth‑oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through the set-up, execution and delivery of assigned trials and contribute to delivery of the sponsors pipeline through accurate planning and efficient execution of trials that bring speed and value to participating subjects and sites.

With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Clinical Trial Manager can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage complex Phase I, II, III, and occasionally IV clinical trials as part of a global clinical operations team.

  • Demonstrate oversight of CROs and work in a quality framework that supports confirmatory trials.

  • Provide direction and leadership in CRO and vendor selection and management.

  • Knowledge of regulatory start up process and planning in support of study start up.

  • Managing and maintaining high performing clinical teams.

  • Coordination of global clinical trials.

  • Provide technical expertise for the development of clinical documents (protocols, monitoring plans, clinical trials report, investigator brochures, etc.) and trial conduct.

  • Coordinate closely with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Data Management, Drug Safety, Legal, Finance, Product Development, Project Management and Regulatory to ensure operational excellence.

  • Be responsible for and manage clinical research activity of Clinical Operations team.

  • Estimate, track and critically analyze vendor financial spend on study.

  • Analyze and develop action plans to address issues with investigational sites, CRAs, and CROs.

  • Provide guidance, direction, and management to site monitoring activity.

  • Coordinate patient enrollment activities and mitigation planning.

  • Coordinate study supplies with regulatory and clinical supplies functions.

  • Negotiate contracts with vendors of clinical trial services.

  • Review Informed Consent Forms, CRFs, and study related materials.

  • Plan and participate in investigator meetings.

  • Assist and support data query process.

  • Assure regulatory compliance of investigational sites with sponsor’s SOPs and FDA and ICH guidelines.

  • Ensures trial master file is current and maintained.

Please note that responsibilities may require a work schedule that may include working outside of “normal” work hours, to meet business demands.

Candidate Profile

You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Extensive experience in clinical trial project management, preferably across international trials.

  • The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly.

  • A patient‑focused mindset and strong attention to detail.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s, nursing degree or equivalent required, science preferred.

  • 5 or more years of industry experience in clinical studies (Pharmaceutical, Biotech or CRO).

  • Proven track record with relevant clinical trials experience, including strong performance as a CRA in the pharmaceutical industry (i.e. biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, medical device).

  • Extensive proven experience of clinical trial management.

  • Experience of managing global clinical trials.

  • Proven management/leadership of people in a matrixed environment.

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines and regulations, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Proficiency with MS Office (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and strong organisational abilities.

  • A willingness to travel, as this position may involve occasional travel, including internationally.

Benefits and Compensation

Benefits include:

  • Medical Aid Contribution.

  • 13th Cheque.
